content: Apart from the datasets, we also developed word embeddings for the Armenian language, which we used in our experiments to train and evaluate named entity recognition algorithms. Considering their ability to capture semantic regularities, we used GloVe to train word embeddings. We assembled a dataset of Armenian texts containing 79 million tokens from the articles of Armenian Wikipedia, The Armenian Soviet Encyclopedia, a subcorpus of Eastern Armenian National Corpus BIBREF12 , over a dozen Armenian news websites and blogs. Included texts covered topics such as economics, politics, weather forecast, IT, law, society and politics, coming from non-fiction as well as fiction genres.
